title: Tanzania safari and Zanzibar Tours
content:
Embark on a 10-day Tanzania Safari and Zanzibar adventure with Tanzania Wildlife Adventures, offering a combination of wildlife exploration and tropical relaxation. Your journey begins with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro or Arusha Airport, followed by visits to Tarangire National Park, Serengeti National Park, Ngorongoro Crater, and Lake Manyara.

These iconic parks offer thrilling game drives, where you’ll witness diverse wildlife, including elephants, lions, cheetahs, and the Great Migration. After your safari, fly to Zanzibar for an enriching cultural experience in Stone Town, and unwind on pristine beaches. Explore the coastline with the Safari Blue Adventure, snorkel in vibrant coral reefs, and enjoy a delicious seafood lunch on a desert island.

This itinerary is fully customizable, allowing you to tailor your trip to your preferences. Whether you’re seeking more wildlife encounters or additional leisure time in Zanzibar, our team is happy to accommodate your requests. From luxury accommodations in Tanzania’s best lodges to the relaxing charm of Zanzibar, we ensure your experience is unforgettable. Book your tailor-made itinerary today for a unique and memorable adventure in Tanzania and Zanzibar.

Where you stay

At Salinero Hotels we do not believe in numbers but we do believe in a service keeping our few customers happy around the clock. Salinero Kilimanjaro is Located 3 Km from Moshi town center in the Leafy suburb of shanty town.

The hotel now blends in simplistic elegance with perfect architectural designs all combined to entice even the most seasoned traveller. Now operating as a 30-room unit, we ensure that clients enjoy personalized service around the clock whilst staying with us. Our well manicured gardens provide the ample settings for your wedding reception or any other special event that you may have.

Endoro Lodge is an Eco friendly safari lodge located on the slops of Ngorongoro highland forest. We have beautiful chalet rooms which are uniquely designed to give our clients an authentic African experience. Our highly skilled stuff uphold the slogan which is integrate with nature for they are all dressed in authentic Masai cloths.

Matawi Serengeti Camp is celebrated for its top-notch service, with guests often commending the staff’s exceptional attentiveness and professionalism. The camp’s ambiance is described as a luxurious sanctuary, offering spacious and well-equipped tents that provide the perfect respite for travelers.

Despite mixed reviews on value, many visitors are enchanted by the clean and opulent rooms, as well as the unique wildlife experiences the location affords. The camp’s food and overall cleanliness receive high marks, enhancing its reputation as a premium destination in the heart of the Serengeti.

As the first beachfront hotel within the UNESCO Heritage Site of Stone Town, Tembo House Hotel has always been one of Zanzibar’s finest hospitality gems. The hotel has welcomed and wowed guests since 1994 and continues to add to the unique history of this island.

The ideal location of Tembo House Hotel means you can easily access the mazy streets of Stone Town to explore the Peace Memorial Museum, the Palace Museum, Forodhani Gardens, the Old Fort, Tippu Tip’s house and all the wonders of the ancient town. By hosting you at Tembo, we continue our great legacy in satisfying guests such as Mahatma Gandhi, Indira Gandhi, Freddie Mercury, Henry Morton Stanley, Ludwig Krapf and more. Karibu Tembo!

The beaches, the palm trees, the waves; nature’s part in creating paradise is done. The only thing that can make your stay on the island better is being as carefree and comfortable as possible. Whether you are looking for a romantic getaway or an active, sporting holiday, we are here to try and make it the paradise you’re after. Karibu Mahali!

faqs.title: What is included in the Tanzania Combo Package?
faqs.content: Our Tanzania Combo Packages include a combination of a Mount Kilimanjaro climb, a thrilling safari experience, and a relaxing stay in Zanzibar. We provide expert guides, park fees, accommodation, meals, and transportation for the entire trip, so you can focus on enjoying your adventure. You can customize your itinerary based on your preferences.

faqs.title: How long does the combo trip last?
faqs.content: The length of the combo trip varies depending on the itinerary you choose. Typically, the Kilimanjaro climb takes 6 to 8 days, followed by 3 to 4 days on safari in top parks like Serengeti and Ngorongoro Crater, and 4 to 5 days in Zanzibar. The total trip can range from 10 to 14 days, depending on your preferences.

faqs.title: Do I need any prior experience for climbing Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: No prior climbing experience is required. However, you should be in good physical condition to handle the altitude and trekking. Our guides will support you throughout the climb, and we recommend some fitness training before your trip. The right preparation will help ensure a safe and enjoyable climb.

faqs.title: What are the best months to visit Tanzania for the combo package?
faqs.content: The best time to visit Tanzania for a combo trip is during the dry seasons, typically from June to October and December to February. These months offer ideal weather for both climbing Mount Kilimanjaro and going on safari, as wildlife is easier to spot, and the conditions are favorable for trekking.

faqs.title: Can I customize my safari experience within the combo package?
faqs.content: Yes! Our combo packages are flexible, and you can customize your safari experience based on your interests. Whether you want to focus on seeing the Big Five, experiencing the Great Migration, or enjoying a private safari with a personal guide, we can tailor the safari to your preferences.

faqs.title: What type of accommodation can I expect during the combo trip?
faqs.content: We offer a variety of accommodation options based on your comfort preferences. For the Kilimanjaro trek, you’ll stay in mountain huts or camping facilities. On safari, you can enjoy luxury lodges and tented camps, depending on your choice. In Zanzibar, we provide a range of options from beachfront resorts to boutique hotels, ensuring a comfortable and relaxing stay.

Gratuities for guides and drivers (optional but appreciated)

itinerary.title: Day 1
itinerary.content:
Welcome to Tanzania! Upon landing at Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport, our friendly driver will meet you with a personalized welcome sign and a warm greeting. You’ll then be transferred comfortably to the Salinero Hotel or a similar accommodation.

Later in the day, join our experienced safari coordinators for a pre-safari briefing, where you’ll learn more about the exciting adventures ahead. Unwind and relax in the peaceful surroundings of the hotel, which features amenities like a swimming pool, lush gardens, a bar, and a restaurant. It’s the perfect start to your unforgettable Tanzanian journey!

Overnight: Sal salinero hotel or similar

itinerary.title: Day 2
itinerary.content:
Begin your day with breakfast before setting out on a drive to Tarangire National Park, a prime destination for exceptional wildlife viewing. Known for its vibrant animal populations, especially in the dry season, Tarangire attracts vast herds gathering around its life-sustaining river. The park’s varied scenery—ranging from lush savannahs and swamps to rugged hills and towering baobabs—offers an impressive backdrop to observe elephants, zebras, buffalo, and sometimes lions and oryx as they roam in search of water.

Bird enthusiasts will appreciate the abundant birdlife, while the Tarangire River remains a crucial water source throughout the dry months. After this immersive day of safari exploration, unwind overnight at Endoro Lodge or a similar accommodation, preparing for more adventures ahead.

####

Endoro Lodge or similar

itinerary.title: Day 3
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, set off toward the legendary Serengeti National Park. The route takes you through the rugged and beautiful landscapes surrounding the park, giving you glimpses of Maasai villages and the open plains that define this world-famous ecosystem. The Serengeti, known for its vast savannas and the renowned Great Migration, offers a chance to spot a diverse range of wildlife, including lions, cheetahs, elephants, and more.

Arrive in the Serengeti in time for an afternoon game drive, where you can experience the thrill of spotting wildlife against the park’s iconic landscapes. In the evening, unwind and enjoy dinner at your Serengeti Camp, resting up for more exploration the next day.

Overnight: Matawi Serengeti Camp or similar

itinerary.title: Day 4
itinerary.content:
Prepare for a full day of exploration in the Serengeti! After an early breakfast, embark on morning and afternoon game drives across the iconic savannas. The Serengeti offers unmatched opportunities for wildlife viewing, where you’ll have the chance to see large prides of lions, and leopards lounging in acacia trees, and herds of wildebeest and zebra roaming the plains.

Your guide will help you track the movements of different animals, potentially witnessing hunting scenes and interactions that reveal the complex dynamics of the Serengeti ecosystem. Enjoy a picnic lunch amid the park’s breathtaking landscapes, then continue your adventure until sunset. Return to your lodge for a restful evening under the Serengeti stars.

####

Matawi Serengeti Camp or similar

itinerary.title: Day 5
itinerary.desc: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Crater and Karatu
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, begin your scenic drive to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, home to the breathtaking Ngorongoro Crater. Upon arrival, descend into the crater to witness its incredible wildlife and striking landscapes. This UNESCO World Heritage Site, often referred to as the “Eighth Wonder of the World,” is teeming with diverse animals, including elephants, lions, rhinos, and flamingos.

After an unforgettable day of exploring the crater, drive to the nearby Karatu area and check into Endoro Lodge or similar, where you can relax and reflect on your remarkable experiences in the heart of Tanzania’s wildlife.

Overnight: Endoro Lodge or similar

itinerary.title: Day 6
itinerary.desc: Lake Manyara National Park and Transfer to Zanzibar
itinerary.content:
Begin your day with breakfast before departing for Lake Manyara National Park, a haven for wildlife enthusiasts. During your game drive, encounter a variety of animals, including elephants, zebras, giraffes, and hippos basking in the park’s waterways. Look out for the iconic tree-climbing lions resting on branches and playful monkeys swinging through the dense forests. Bird lovers will delight in spotting flamingos, pelicans, and colorful kingfishers around the scenic Soda Lake.

In the late afternoon, transfer to Arusha Airport for your flight to Zanzibar. Upon arrival, you will be warmly greeted and taken to your hotel, ready to relax and enjoy the island’s serene beauty.

Overnight: Tembo House Hotel

itinerary.title: Day 7
itinerary.content:
Start your day with a guided tour of Stone Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the cultural heart of Zanzibar. Wander through its narrow streets, lined with historic buildings showcasing a mix of Arab, Indian, and European influences. Visit iconic landmarks such as the House of Wonders, the Old Fort, and the Sultan’s Palace. Discover the vibrant Darajani Market, where local spices, fresh produce, and handcrafted items abound.

Immerse yourself in the island’s rich history and culture as you explore Stone Town’s vibrant atmosphere. After the tour, return to Mahali Zanzibar, where you can unwind and prepare for the next day’s adventures.

Overnight: Mahali Zanzibar or similar

itinerary.title: Day 8
itinerary.content:
Enjoy a full day at your own pace, soaking in the beauty of Zanzibar. Spend your time relaxing on the pristine beaches, taking in the turquoise waters and soft white sands. For those seeking more activity, optional excursions such as snorkeling, diving, or visiting a spice farm can be arranged.

Unwind amidst the serene coastal ambiance, indulging in the hospitality and comfort of Mahali Zanzibar. As the sun sets, savor a delicious dinner and reflect on the tranquil island moments.

Overnight: Mahali Zanzibar (Half Board)

itinerary.title: Day 9
itinerary.content:
Spend an exciting day exploring the stunning coastal waters of Zanzibar. Begin your adventure from a quaint fishing village in the southwest of the island, venturing into a bay surrounded by uninhabited islands and pristine sandbanks. Keep an eye out for humpback and bottlenose dolphins that often grace these waters. Snorkel in the vibrant coral reefs, teeming with marine life, and refresh yourself with a green coconut before heading to a desert island for a delightful lunch.

Lunch features a traditional Zanzibar seafood feast, served picnic-style under the shade of tamarind trees. Throughout the day, enjoy a variety of cold drinks, including mineral water, sodas, and beer. Depending on the tides, you may have the opportunity to swim through a serene mangrove lagoon, surrounded by lush forest.

In the evening, return to your lodge to relax and unwind.

Overnight: Mahali Zanzibar (Half Board)

itinerary.title: Day 10
itinerary.content:
After enjoying a leisurely breakfast, you will have some free time to relax and reflect on your unforgettable experiences in Zanzibar. In the late morning, you will be transferred to Zanzibar Airport in plenty of time for your flight to Dar es Salaam. From there, you will connect to your international departure flight.

We hope your journey with us has been full of memorable moments, from the wildlife adventures in Tanzania to the tropical beauty of Zanzibar. Thank you for choosing Tanzania Wildlife Adventure, and we look forward to welcoming you back on your next adventure. Safe travels and we wish you all the best as you head home!
